summary: Full-stack regression for SIXNEMA. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests pass covering auth (3 roles + cookie session), students CRUD + RBAC, grade snapshots (PATCH creates snapshot, /grade-history monthly aggregation), journals (with auto attendance_summary), attendance persistence, artworks (siswa scope + pembina all), feedback, and CSV exports. Frontend: all 3 role flows work end-to-end. Session persists across reload via /auth/me. Pembina dashboard shows 15 siswa and Aisyah Zahra 94.4 at rank #1. Absensi, Jurnal, Nilai, GradeChart (Recharts SVG rendered with 8 svg elements), Kelola Siswa (add + delete), and Riwayat Absensi all functional with success toasts. Siswa Karya submission + Rapor chart (6 line series rendered) work. Waka feedback submit + Riwayat visible. Ranking CSV export triggers real download (sixnema-ranking.csv). Logout returns to auth screen for all roles - previous iteration bug is fixed.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> - likely caused by dev instrumentation wrapping option children; verify no visual issue but suppress to keep console clean

critical_code_review_comments: Backend still has no brute-force login lockout (auth_testing.md requests 5-fail lockout). Currently unlimited login attempts.
seed_grade_history() only runs when the collection is empty; if snapshots collection is manually seeded once with wrong data it will never refresh. Minor.

PembinaJurnal grade select wraps <option>{s.name} ({s.class})</option> which triggers a hydration warning under the current dev instrumentation. Consider concatenating into a single string to silence.

compute_attendance_summary picks 'latest' by created_at, not by attendance date - if user backfills an older date, the summary still reflects most-recently-created record. Acceptable but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: Tests created and cleaned up a TEST_ student via Pembina API. A grade snapshot for student-1 was added via PATCH (persistent - increases snapshot count each run). One TEST attendance for 2026-01-30, one TEST journal, one TEST artwork for student-1, and one TEST waka feedback were created via API and remain in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://photography-tracker-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_sixnema.py (run via `pytest backend/tests/test_sixnema.py`). Auth uses httpOnly cookies with samesite=none & secure=true; requests.Session preserves cookies. Siswa demo account is bound to student-1 so grade-history 200 for student-1 and 403 for student-2. Chart renders when snapshots exist; empty state uses data-testid=grade-chart-empty otherwise. Frontend testids: SiswaDashboard uses art-title-input, art-url-input, art-desc-input, submit-artwork-btn; Waka uses waka-feedback-input, waka-send-feedback-btn.
rca of the issue: N/A - no blocking issues found this iteration.
